description: One metric row of a TmTrendList: a label, its value, an optional change over the comparison period, an optional sparkline and an optional link target. The row is data, not behaviour — it carries no callbacks, so a host that needs a row action passes a safe Href and the row stays one native focus stop.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the row, rendered as data-item-id — never as a DOM id, because a host value is not a valid id (a.b and a-b would collide in a selector).

members.name: Label
members.description: The metric's name, rendered as the row's label (and as the link text when Href renders).

members.name: Value
members.description: The host-formatted value, rendered verbatim (e.g. "2.1 %" or "42"). Ignored when NumericValue is set.

members.name: NumericValue
members.description: The value as a NUMBER; when set it wins over Value and is formatted with the list's ValueFormat and Culture.

members.name: Delta
members.description: The change over the comparison period in percent points, formatted with the culture's own percent convention. Null renders no change marker at all.

members.name: PositiveIsGood
members.description: Whether a rise is the good outcome for THIS metric. It decides the tone only — never the direction word or the arrow — so a falling churn rate is painted as good news and still reads "Decrease".

members.name: Sparkline
members.description: Optional mini chart of the metric's history, rendered through TmSparkline. Null renders nothing; the chart keeps its own accessible name, so it is a text alternative rather than a decorative squiggle.

members.name: Href
members.description: Optional navigation target, rendered as one native <a> around the label. Only a relative URL and the http, https and mailto schemes render; a refused value (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, a protocol-relative //host, or a value carrying a control character a browser would strip before reading the scheme) means NO target at all rather than a rewritten link.
